reuse.why: Uses the existing getMonthActionCategories selection and getSheetValue 'sum-amount-' cells, and extracts setBudgetsForActionCategories so the new action and the existing average actions share the same loop and income guard.

duplication.why: The loop/income guard is now shared, but setZero still keeps its own copy of it and the income/expense sign flip is restated in each amount callback.

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts next to its siblings and is registered in budget/app.ts with the same mutator(undoable(...)) wrapping.

scope.why: Limited to the new action, its registration, tests and a refactor of the directly related average path.

maintainability.why: A clear shared helper with a per-category amount callback; leaving setZero outside it leaves one more copy of the category/income rule to keep in step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The new action goes through getMonthActionCategories and setBudget like the existing month-wide actions.

disguised_duplication.where: Shared logic was extracted into setBudgetsForActionCategories rather than copied.
